question: Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id  WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o'  GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts

A.clarification: 이 DB에서 atom과 bond는 둘 다 molecule_id 컬럼을 가지고 있습니다.
A.revised_sql:
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND a.element = 'o'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS oxygen_counts
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-');

B.clarification: atom과 bond를 연결할 때, connected 테이블을 거쳐야 하나요, 아니면 둘 다 가진 molecule_id로 바로 연결해도 되나요?
B.revised_sql:
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND a.element = 'o'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS oxygen_counts;

C.clarification: connected 테이블 없이, atom과 bond를 molecule_id로 직접 조인해서 계산해주세요.
C.revised_sql:
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-' AND a.element = 'o'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS oxygen_counts;

gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '+'

A.revised_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id 
FROM molecule m 
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

B.clarification: 결과에 분자 ID만 필요한가요, 아니면 label 값도 같이 보여줘야 하나요?
B.revised_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id 
FROM molecule m 
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id 
WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '+';

C.revised_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id

question: What elements are in a double type bond?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN connected AS T3 ON T1.atom_id = T3.atom_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '='

A.clarification: 결합은 두 원자를 연결합니다. 원소 종류 자체는 몇 가지 안 됩니다 (c, o, h, n 등).
A.revised_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element 
FROM connected c 
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id 
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id 
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id 
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

B.clarification: 결합에 참여하는 원소를 '쌍'으로 나열하길 원하시나요, 아니면 등장하는 원소의 '종류 목록'을 원하시나요?
B.revised_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a1.element 
FROM connected c 
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id 
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id 
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

C.clarification: 쌍이 아니라, 중복 없이 원소 종류만 하나의 리스트로 반환해주세요.
C.revised_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a1.element 
FROM connected c 
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id 
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id 
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id 
WHERE b.bond_type = '=';

question: How many atoms with iodine and with sulfur type elements are there in single bond molecules?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 'i' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS iodine_nums , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element = 's' THEN T1.atom_id ELSE NULL END) AS sulfur_nums FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '-'

A.revised_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (a.element = 'i' AND b.bond_type = '-') OR (a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = '-');

B.clarification: iodine 개수와 sulfur 개수를 하나로 합친 값을 원하시나요, 아니면 각각 따로 알고 싶으신가요?
B.revised_sql:
SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS atom_count
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (a.element = 'i' OR a.element = 's') AND b.bond_type = '-'
GROUP BY a.element;

C.clarification: 두 원소의 개수를 각각 별도의 컬럼으로 따로 반환해주세요.
C.revised_sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN a.atom_id END) AS iodine_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_count
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

question: What percentage of carcinogenic-type molecules does not contain fluorine?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T1.element <> 'f' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+'

A.clarification: 한 분자 안에 여러 개의 원자가 있을 수 있습니다.
A.revised_sql:
SELECT 100 - (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN m.molecule_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)) AS percentage_non_fluorine
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element != 'f');

B.clarification: '불소를 포함하지 않는다'는 게, 그 분자의 모든 원자가 불소가 아니라는 뜻인가요, 아니면 불소가 아닌 원자가 하나라도 있으면 되는 건가요?
B.revised_sql:
SELECT 100 - (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN m.molecule_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)) AS percentage_non_fluorine
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND m.molecule_id NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT m2.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m2
    JOIN atom a2 ON m2.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
    WHERE a2.element = 'f'
);

C.clarification: 분자 안에 불소 원자가 하나도 없는 경우만 '포함 안 함'으로 계산해주세요.
C.revised_sql:
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN m.molecule_id END)) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage_non_fluorine
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' 
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN a.atom_id END) = 0;

question: Which bond type accounted for the majority of the bonds found in molecule TR010 and state whether or not this molecule is carcinogenic?
gold_sql: SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT T1.bond_type, COUNT(T1.molecule_id) FROM bond AS T1  WHERE T1.molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY T1.bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(T1.molecule_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T

A.revised_sql:
SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

B.clarification: 결과에 개수(count)도 같이 보여줘야 하나요, 아니면 bond_type 값만 필요한가요?
B.revised_sql:
SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_type) AS bond_count
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

C.revised_sql:
SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: What are the atoms of the triple bond with the molecule "TR041"?
gold_sql: SELECT T2.atom_id, T2.atom_id2 FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#' AND T3.molecule_id = 'TR041'

A.clarification: bond 테이블의 한 row는 두 원자 사이의 결합 하나를 의미합니다.
A.revised_sql:
SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id 
FROM bond b 
JOIN connected c1 ON b.bond_id = c1.bond_id 
JOIN connected c2 ON c1.atom_id2 = c2.atom_id 
JOIN atom a1 ON c1.atom_id = a1.atom_id 
JOIN atom a2 ON c2.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id 
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

B.clarification: 'triple bond의 원자들'이 세 개의 원자를 찾으라는 뜻인가요, 아니면 그 결합에 참여하는 두 원자를 찾으라는 뜻인가요?
B.revised_sql:
SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id 
FROM connected c 
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id 
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id1 = a1.atom_id 
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id 
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

C.clarification: triple bond는 원자 두 개 사이의 결합입니다. 그 결합에 연결된 두 원자만 반환해주세요.
C.revised_sql:
SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id 
FROM connected c 
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id 
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id1 = a1.atom_id 
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id 
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

question: Tally the toxicology element of the 4th atom of each molecule that was carcinogenic.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.element FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.label = '+' AND SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, -1) = '4' AND LENGTH(T1.atom_id) = 7

A.clarification: atom_id의 길이는 분자마다 다를 수 있습니다 (원자가 10개 넘는 분자도 있음).
A.revised_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND LENGTH(a.atom_id) >= 7 AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 1) = '4';

B.clarification: atom_id의 특정 위치(7번째 글자)를 보는 게 맞나요, 아니면 원자 번호가 항상 마지막 자리에 오는 걸 기준으로 봐야 하나요?
B.revised_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, -1) = '4';

C.clarification: atom_id 뒤에서부터 세어서 마지막 글자가 '4'인 것만 찾아주세요. 단, 전체 길이가 7자리인 것만 (두 자리 번호는 제외).
C.revised_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND LENGTH(a.atom_id) = 7 AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, -1) = '4';

question: Which non-carcinogenic molecules consisted more than 5 atoms?
gold_sql: SELECT T.molecule_id FROM ( SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T2.atom_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.label = '-' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id HAVING COUNT(T2.atom_id) > 5 ) t

A.clarification: label 값은 이미 조건절(WHERE label = '-')에 사용되고 있습니다.
A.revised_sql:
SELECT m.molecule_id 
FROM molecule m 
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id 
GROUP BY m.molecule_id 
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5 AND m.label = '-';

B.clarification: 결과에 label도 같이 보여줘야 하나요, molecule_id만 있으면 되나요?
B.revised_sql:
SELECT m.molecule_id 
FROM molecule m 
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '-' 
GROUP BY m.molecule_id 
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5;

C.revised_sql:
SELECT m.molecule_id 
FROM molecule m 
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id 
WHERE m.label = '-' 
GROUP BY m.molecule_id 
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5;
